lines:
| Any GSAP animation, starting from zero | [`gsap-core`](../gsap-core/SKILL.reference.md) |
| Multi-step sequence or choreography | [`gsap-timeline`](../gsap-timeline/SKILL.reference.md) |
| Per-word or per-character text animation | [`gsap-plugins`](../gsap-plugins/SKILL.reference.md) (SplitText section) |
| SVG shape morph | [`gsap-plugins`](../gsap-plugins/SKILL.reference.md) (MorphSVG section) |
| Object following a curved path | [`gsap-plugins`](../gsap-plugins/SKILL.reference.md) (MotionPath section) |
| Custom bezier easing | [`gsap-plugins`](../gsap-plugins/SKILL.reference.md) (CustomEase section) |
| GSAP inside a React component (Remotion) | [`gsap-react`](../gsap-react/SKILL.reference.md) |
| Math helpers (clamp, mapRange, interpolate, random) | [`gsap-utils`](../gsap-utils/SKILL.reference.md) |
| Debugging slow animations | [`gsap-performance`](../gsap-performance/SKILL.reference.md) |
| Scroll-driven animation (web preview only, not video render) | [`gsap-scrolltrigger`](../gsap-scrolltrigger/SKILL.reference.md) |
| Vue / Svelte / non-React host | [`gsap-frameworks`](../gsap-frameworks/SKILL.reference.md) |
